closingKeywordReason: Both halves of #1569 are fixed in the function the issue names (katana's ledger load/append): unknown fields on existing rows pass through unchanged and the file is re-serialized at its detected indentation, so an append to a v2 ledger diffs only the appended rows. The same 2-space hard-code in canary-unquarantine settle.mjs is a separate writer (out of scope, in-flight PR #1620) and is tracked as a follow-up, not part of #1569.
assumptions: Field order of an existing row is preserved (canonical v2 fields missing from a row are appended at the end of that row), not re-sorted into canonical order.
The v1 ticket -> issue migration still rewrites a loaded row (ticket is removed once migrated), since it renames a known field rather than dropping an unknown one.
Indentation is detected from the first indented line of the existing file; a missing, empty, or single-line file falls back to the 2-space default.

A ledger formatted by a tool whose layout differs from JSON.stringify (e.g. compact one-line rows) is still re-laid-out on append; only indentation width/character is detected, per the human-answered fork.
